title: Locally constant finite type sheaves form a weak Serre subcategory
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and $B$ a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. The full subcategory of sheaves of $\underline B$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] which are locally constant of finite type is closed under kernels and cokernels of morphisms between its objects, and under extensions in the abelian category of sheaves of $\underline B$-modules. Here $\underline B$ is the constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]; locally constant of finite type means that locally on the site the sheaf is isomorphic to the constant sheaf associated to a finitely generated $B$-module. No existence of points of the site is assumed.
